moves.label: Trade: David Michineau, Kessler Edwards

moves.label: Trade: Jae Crowder, George Hill, Serge Ibaka, Jordan Nwora, Kevin Durant and others
moves.description: Jae Crowder was acquired by the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for George Hill, Serge Ibaka, Jordan Nwora, a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a 2024 2nd round pick (MIL own), a 2025 2nd round pick (IND own), a 2028 2nd round pick (MIL own) and a 2029 2nd round pick (MIL own). Kevin Durant and T.J. Warren were acquired by the Phoenix Suns in exchange for Mikal Bridges, Jae Crowder, Cameron Johnson, a 2023 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2025 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2027 1st round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2028 1st round picks and a 2029 1st round pick (PHX own). George Hill, Serge Ibaka, Jordan Nwora, a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a 2024 2nd round pick (MIL own), a 2025 2nd round pick (IND own) and cash were acquired by the Indiana Pacers in exchange for the draft rights to Juan Vaulet. Mikal Bridges, Cameron Johnson, the draft rights to Juan Vaulet, a 2023 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2025 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2027 1st round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2028 1st round picks, a 2028 2nd round pick (MIL own), a 2029 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2029 2nd round pick (MIL own) and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Brooklyn Nets in exchange for Kevin Durant, T.J. Warren and cash.

moves.label: Trade: Royce O'Neale, David Roddy, Keita Bates-Diop, Jordan Goodwin, Chimezie Metu and others
moves.description: Royce O'Neale and David Roddy were acquired by the Phoenix Suns in exchange for Keita Bates-Diop, Jordan Goodwin, Chimezie Metu, Yuta Watanabe, a Swap 2026 1st round picks, a Least Favorable 2026 2nd round pick, a 2028 2nd round pick (MEM own), a 2029 2nd round pick (MEM own) and a TPE. Chimezie Metu, Yuta Watanabe, a Swap 2026 1st round picks and a TPE were acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for David Roddy and the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic. Keita Bates-Diop, Jordan Goodwin, the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic, a Least Favorable 2026 2nd round pick, a 2028 2nd round pick (MEM own), a 2029 2nd round pick (MEM own) and a TPE were acquired by the Brooklyn Nets in exchange for Royce O'Neale and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Adou Thiero, Adou Thiero, Rocco Zikarsky, Jahmai Mashack, Alex Toohey and others
moves.description: A 2030 2nd round pick (BOS own) was acquired by the Brooklyn Nets in exchange for the draft rights to Adou Thiero and a Swap 2026 2nd round picks. The draft rights to Adou Thiero was acquired by the Los Angeles Lakers in exchange for the draft rights to Rocco Zikarsky and cash. The draft rights to Jahmai Mashack and the draft rights to Alex Toohey were acquired by the Golden State Warriors in exchange for the draft rights to Koby Brea. Clint Capela, Kevin Durant and a Swap 2026 2nd round picks were acquired by the Houston Rockets in exchange for Dillon Brooks, Jalen Green, the draft rights to Khaman Maluach, the draft rights to Jahmai Mashack, a More Favorable 2026 2nd round pick, a 2030 2nd round pick (BOS own), a Swap 2031 2nd round picks, a 2032 2nd round pick (HOU own) and cash. The draft rights to Rocco Zikarsky, a Least Favorable 2026 2nd round pick, a More Favorable 2032 2nd round pick and cash were acquired by the Minnesota Timberwolves in exchange for the draft rights to Rasheer Fleming. Dillon Brooks, Jalen Green, the draft rights to Koby Brea, the draft rights to Rasheer Fleming, the draft rights to Khaman Maluach, a More Favorable 2026 2nd round pick and a 2032 2nd round pick (HOU own) were acquired by the Phoenix Suns in exchange for Kevin Durant, the draft rights to Alex Toohey, a Least Favorable 2026 2nd round pick and a More Favorable 2032 2nd round pick.
